meta.provinceCountBasis: Natural Earth Admin 1 features grouped by ISO 3166-2 code, plus explicitly identified Natural Earth-only candidates and one noSubdivision placeholder where both sources list no subdivision. This is not a definitive official total for countries with conflicts.
meta.hierarchyCaveat: ISO 3166-2 lists subdivision codes but does not encode a universal ADM1 hierarchy. Countries whose full ISO code set differs from Natural Earth Admin 1 are marked conflict; ISO-only codes are not silently counted as first-level provinces.
